summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profiles, including user actions and associated data, formatted for user interfaces.
purpose: Provide a detailed change history for site profiles with user-specific details.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date when the action was performed

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user involved

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Flag if the user is a system administrator

system_behavior: Retrieve and format user action data into history records
dependencies: Database procedures for history data retrieval
